title: Skills teach `forms:` as the one way to declare a form, and `views:` as lists only (ADR-0159, card ④s)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Source: ADR-0159 (PR #36957), Execution plan row ④ and D5 ("Skills and docs teach the new shape from card ④"). Parent: #36868, card ④ of five, the published-skill part, cut from #37088 because an implementation card's surface never includes `skills/**`.

Blocked-by: #37086
Blocked-by: #37087
Metadata-protocol: none
Clause-②: no

Grading: `area:build` · Enhancement · the published skill teaches `forms:` as the one way to declare a form and `views:` as lists · AI authors and app authors who build from the skill · evidence: `git grep -lE "formViews|viewKind: 'form'" -- skills` at `main` `254e396a29e` names three files, all under `skills/objectstack-ui`: `SKILL.md`, `rules/list-views.md`, `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`. p2.

Governed surface: `skills/**` is Tier H. The PR is pushed, opened and left awaiting its tier's record; ⛔ no AI seat merges, queues or arms auto-merge on it.

## Why this waits for card ③

Until card ③ lands the shipped console reads forms from `view`. A skill that teaches `forms:` before then teaches an action-opened form that answers not found and a public form Setup does not list. ⛔ Do not start this card beside card ③.

## What to do

1. In `skills/objectstack-ui`, teach one way to declare a form: a `form` item in `forms:`, with `name` (`OBJECT.KEY`, the part before the last segment equal to `object`), `object`, and the form body at the top level (no `viewKind`, no `config`, no `data`). `defineForm` is this type's factory. `views:` is lists.
2. Teach what is `form` content and what is not (ADR-0159 D1): a public form (it declares a `sharing.publicLink`) or a form an action of type `form` opens. The record create and edit form is the object's `fieldGroups` and is ⛔ never a `form` item.
3. Teach the two refusals an author meets: a public address another form holds is refused, naming both forms (a switched-off form that keeps its link still holds its address); `data` on a `form` item is refused with "bind the form with `object`".
4. Teach translations under the `forms` family (`forms.NAME.title`, `.label`, `.description`, `.submitBehavior.*`, `.sections.*`), with `objects.OBJECT._sections.SECTION` as the section default.
5. Remove every example that authors a form inside a view (`formViews`, a `viewKind: 'form'` item, a container's `form:` member). ⛔ Do not teach the old shapes as an alternative; one sentence may say they are refused and name `os migrate meta`.
6. Update `rules/list-views.md` and the eval file so the evals exercise a `form` item and no eval expects an old shape.

## Done when

- `git grep -nE "formViews|viewKind: 'form'" -- skills` returns nothing but the one migration sentence, quoted in the PR. No skill example keeps a `form:` member in a `defineView` container (the grep does not match that shape; read each example).
- Every `form` example in the skill parses with the `FormSchema` card ② added (run the skill's example check, or parse each by hand and paste the result).
- The two size readings a `skills/` diff owes are in the PR (whole file and whole pack, before and after); growth is paid by deletion.
- The skill's evals pass, and at least one exercises a public `form` item and one an action-opened `form` item.
- The gates `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` names for this file surface are green, listed in the PR.

## Not in this card

- Examples and docs pages (#37088). HotCRM's sources (its own card).
- No spec, server or console change.
- Any file under `ui/skills/**` that teaches forms: name it in the report for the seat; it is not edited here.

Dedupe words: skills forms teaching, objectstack-ui skill forms collection, defineForm skill.
